$comment: Run-up papers and rallies of the three offices. Assembled by content-assemble from mayor-runup-scripted, governor-places-runup, events-runup.

runUp.text: Judge the {district} Prize Hedge Show. Say nothing about the leaning one.
runUp.subject: hedges

runUp.text: Open the {district} tea dance. Your dance card is in triplicate.
runUp.subject: ceremonies
runUp.note: replaces may-runup-pop-in (a third fête in the file; 'pop in' against four hours was mild)

runUp.text: Award {district}'s best-kept bench. Do not sit on it. It is kept.
runUp.subject: ceremonies
runUp.note: visitor Bertram Loam (slow, careful) for a face other than Rodney's

runUp.text: Wear the {district} fête sash: GUEST OF HONOUR (SELF-NOMINATED).
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Lay {district}'s first paving stone. The second says you did.
runUp.subject: vanity
runUp.note: retagged undercut (the second stone deflates the first); visitor Rodney (vanity is his)

runUp.text: Judge the {district} fruit show. Declare any baskets first.
runUp.subject: vegetable-shows
runUp.note: Gwendolyn speaks (the Treasury Clerk asks for interests declared); calls back to the first fruit basket, which every player meets at 0:38

runUp.text: Open the {district} jumble sale. Your old hat is on table three.
runUp.subject: hats

runUp.text: Tour {district}: 5 minutes for you, 15 for photographs of you.
runUp.subject: vanity
runUp.note: replaces may-runup-twenty-minutes: the same idea, with the punch in the last words

runUp.text: Lean on the {district} gate, thoughtfully. The gate is on loan.
runUp.subject: vanity
runUp.note: replaces may-runup-soup (too close to gold G8, 'say goodness, we will cue you')

runUp.text: Unveil a plaque in {district}, where you once unveiled a plaque.
runUp.subject: ceremonies
runUp.note: replaces may-runup-visitors-book (its escalation tag was not honest, and the governor run-up already signs a roll of honour)

runUp.text: Plant a tree in {district}. It will be photogenic in 40 years.
runUp.subject: gardens

runUp.text: Point at something in {district}. Rodney will say what, later.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Judge the {district} hats. Yours has entered. Declare an interest.
runUp.subject: hats

runUp.text: Open the {district} bridge. Again for the camera. Again for the minutes.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Pin the {district} show rosette on the winner. Not on you.
runUp.subject: vegetable-shows

runUp.text: Cut the {district} cake. The icing reads THE GOVERNOR CUT THIS.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Award the {district} prizes: best scone, best rose, best photo of you.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Sign the {district} roll of honour. Not the napkin; that is the law.
runUp.subject: paperwork

runUp.text: Sit by the water in {district}. Say nothing. You will be quoted.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Tour {district}: 14 benches, and not one has your name. Yet.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Break new ground in {district}. Gently; it is the bowling green.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Present the {district} band cup. We play you on. Off. And on.
runUp.subject: bandstands

runUp.text: Cut the {district} ribbon. Cuthbert needs both halves signed for.
runUp.subject: ribbons

runUp.text: Pose with the {district} prize pumpkin. Mind its good side.
runUp.subject: vegetable-shows

runUp.text: Open the {district} flower show. No ribbon. Put the scissors away.
runUp.subject: gardens

runUp.text: Ride the {district} bus. Wave at each stop. Each wave is logged.
runUp.subject: buses

runUp.text: Hold the {district} ribbon. Someone else cuts it. Smile anyway.
runUp.subject: ribbons

runUp.text: Open the {district} band festival. The band will play you in. Then out.
runUp.subject: bandstands

runUp.text: Present the {district} cup. It reads: THE PRESIDENT, AND THE WINNER.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Inspect the {district} fishing pegs. Nod. Nodding has a form.
runUp.subject: paperwork

runUp.text: Sit for the {district} art club. They asked for a bowl of fruit.
runUp.subject: portraits

runUp.text: Read the {district} timetable aloud. All of it. Mervyn checks.
runUp.subject: buses

runUp.text: Take questions at the {district} parrot show. Answer each one twice.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Pose by the oldest tree in {district}. Look wise. It will cope.
runUp.subject: gardens

runUp.text: Take tea at Till's Teas in {district}. Keep the name showing.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Throw a hoop at the {district} fair. Three cameras. One go.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Unveil the {district} weathervane. It points at you, as arranged.
runUp.subject: signage

runUp.text: Judge the {district} Quiet Competition. Applaud in silence.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Start the {district} duck race. The ducks have been briefed.
runUp.subject: ducks

runUp.text: Launch the {district} kite. You hold it up. Philomena runs.
runUp.subject: kites

runUp.text: Unveil a copy of the founding napkin in {district}. Do not use it.
runUp.subject: paperwork

runUp.text: Unveil the {district} hedge sign. It is a hedge, trimmed to read HEDGE.
runUp.subject: signage

runUp.text: Open the {district} flower show. Smell all 400 roses.
runUp.subject: gardens

runUp.text: Open the {district} library. Your book is on loan. To you.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Judge the {district} dog show. Rodney has taught one to wave.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

runUp.text: Cut the {district} cheese. A ribbon has been tied round it.
runUp.subject: ribbons

runUp.text: Judge the {district} shop windows. You are in all twelve.
runUp.subject: vanity

runUp.text: Tour the {district} allotments. Hilda introduces each onion.
runUp.subject: vegetable-shows

runUp.text: Open the {district} model railway. Tiny ribbon, tiny scissors, same smile.
runUp.subject: ribbons

runUp.text: Ring the {district} bell once. Then once for the photograph.
runUp.subject: ceremonies

rallies.text: A rally at the fête. The budget allows one snip. Do not miss.
rallies.subject: ribbons
rallies.note: replaces may-rally-loan-scissors ('snips are counted' read close to counting in an election paper; Gwendolyn was only implied)

rallies.text: Hold a rally at the bandstand. Bring the ceremonial scissors. Cut something.
rallies.subject: ribbons

rallies.text: A rally at the vegetable show. Cut the ribbon. Not the pumpkin.
rallies.subject: vegetable-shows
rallies.note: retagged undercut: a warning that deflates the ceremony, not a phrase taken at its word

rallies.text: A rally at the flower show. Hold the scissors up for the Drizzle. Higher. Good.
rallies.subject: ribbons
rallies.note: 'the show' made concrete; Rodney directing the photograph

rallies.text: A rally at the bandstand: 40 chairs, and one more for your hat.
rallies.subject: bandstands

rallies.text: A rally at the fête, on a hay bale marked GOVERNOR (KEEP OFF).
rallies.subject: signage

rallies.text: A rally on the green. Standing on it needs a permit. Queue on it.
rallies.subject: paperwork

rallies.text: A rally in the square. Rodney has had your soapbox raised, slightly.
rallies.subject: vanity

rallies.text: A rally at the kite festival. Cut the ribbon on a kite. Watch it go.
rallies.subject: ribbons

rallies.text: A rally at the bandstand. Your scissors arrive in a box, in a box.
rallies.subject: ribbons

rallies.text: A rally at the hedge show. Bring shears. Agnes will say which leaf.
rallies.subject: hedges

rallies.text: A rally at the fête. Rodney has brought nine ribbons, in case.
rallies.subject: ribbons
